name: codex-harness-builder
description: Analyze a software repository and build a minimal, token-efficient Codex development harness with project context and custom agent roles.

interface.longDescription: Analyze the current software repository and create a non-destructive, token-efficient Codex development harness. It can generate concise AGENTS.md guidance, project context files, role-specific subagent configurations, decision and lesson logs, and planning scaffolding based on repository complexity. V1 is skills-only and does not connect to external services.
